## The hero on the wall walk: slides along X only and fires on its own (GDD 5.1, 6.2).
## Aims at the nearest scarecrow inside the upward cone; holds fire when there is none.

signal fired(arrow: Arrow)

const ARROW_SCENE := preload("res://game/arrow.tscn")

var arrows_parent: Node
var fire_cooldown := 0.0
var release_window := false


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	var axis := Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	position.x = clampf(position.x + axis * Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * delta,
			Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN, Tuning.VIEW.x - Tuning.ARCHER_MARGIN)
	fire_cooldown = maxf(fire_cooldown - delta, 0.0)
	if fire_cooldown > 0.0:
		return
	var target := nearest_target()
	if target:
		_fire_at(target)
		fire_cooldown = Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL


func nearest_target() -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_dist := INF
	var half_cone := deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0)
	for enemy in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := enemy as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead():
			continue
		var to := s.global_position - global_position
		if absf(Vector2.UP.angle_to(to)) > half_cone:
			continue
		if to.length() < best_dist:
			best_dist = to.length()
			best = s
	return best


func _fire_at(target: Scarecrow) -> void:
	var arrow := ARROW_SCENE.instantiate() as Arrow
	var from := global_position + Vector2(0, -24)
	arrow.launch(from, target.global_position - from)
	(arrows_parent if arrows_parent else get_parent()).add_child(arrow)
	fired.emit(arrow)

class_name Game
extends Node2D
## One prototype run: survive SURVIVE_TIME seconds of scarecrows without losing the gate.
## Owns the run state (gate HP, elapsed time, kills, win/lose). Restart with R/Enter at the end.

signal state_changed(new_state: State)

enum State { PLAYING, WON, LOST }

const SCARECROW_SCENE := preload("res://game/scarecrow.tscn")
const ARCHER_START := Vector2(640, 572)

@export var spawning_enabled := true
## (start, end) spawn interval used instead of Tuning's when non-zero; only tools/balance_sim.gd sets it.
var spawn_interval_override := Vector2.ZERO

var state: State = State.PLAYING
var gate_hp: float = Tuning.GATE_HP
var elapsed := 0.0
var kills := 0
var spawn_timer := 0.0
var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()

@onready var world: Node2D = $World
@onready var enemies: Node2D = $World/Enemies
@onready var arrows: Node2D = $World/Arrows
@onready var archer: Archer = $World/Archer


func _ready() -> void:
	rng.randomize()
	archer.arrows_parent = arrows
	reset()


func reset() -> void:
	for child in enemies.get_children() + arrows.get_children():
		if child.is_in_group("enemies"):
			child.remove_from_group("enemies")
		child.queue_free()
	gate_hp = Tuning.GATE_HP
	elapsed = 0.0
	kills = 0
	spawn_timer = 1.0
	archer.position = ARCHER_START
	archer.fire_cooldown = 0.0
	world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
	_set_state(State.PLAYING)


func spawn_scarecrow(at: Vector2) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := SCARECROW_SCENE.instantiate() as Scarecrow
	s.position = at
	s.died.connect(func() -> void: kills += 1)
	s.attacking_gate.connect(_on_attacking_gate)
	enemies.add_child(s)
	return s


func spawn_interval() -> float:
	var t := clampf(elapsed / Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME, 0.0, 1.0)
	if spawn_interval_override != Vector2.ZERO:
		return lerpf(spawn_interval_override.x, spawn_interval_override.y, t)
	return lerpf(Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_START, Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_END, t)


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if state != State.PLAYING:
		return
	elapsed += delta
	if elapsed >= Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME:
		_end(State.WON)
		return
	if spawning_enabled:
		spawn_timer -= delta
		if spawn_timer <= 0.0:
			spawn_timer += spawn_interval()
			spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(rng.randf_range(60.0, Tuning.VIEW.x - 60.0), -40.0))


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if state != State.PLAYING and event.is_action_pressed("restart"):
		reset()


func _on_attacking_gate(amount: float) -> void:
	if state != State.PLAYING:
		return
	gate_hp = maxf(gate_hp - amount, 0.0)
	if gate_hp <= 0.0:
		_end(State.LOST)


func _end(result: State) -> void:
	world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED   # freeze the field; HUD shows the result
	_set_state(result)


func _set_state(s: State) -> void:
	state = s
	state_changed.emit(s)
class_name Scarecrow
extends Node2D
## Straw Scarecrow: walks down to the wall and hits the gate. Straw burns.
## Owns the Burning state: burn_time_left > 0 means burning. Fire refreshes it to the full
## BURN_DURATION (a second hit does not stack damage). Timed in physics time, so it follows
## Engine.time_scale and stops while the tree is paused.

signal burning_started
signal burning_ended
signal died
signal attacking_gate(amount: float)
signal hit_taken(position: Vector2)

const BURN_END_EPSILON := 1e-9      # s; float residue below this counts as burnt out

var hp: float = Tuning.SCARECROW_HP
var burn_time_left: float = 0.0
var at_wall := false


func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("enemies")
	at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y


func is_burning() -> bool:
	return burn_time_left > 0.0


func is_dead() -> bool:
	return hp <= 0.0


func hit(damage: float, element: StringName) -> void:
	if is_dead():
		return
	hp -= damage
	if element == &"fire":
		ignite()
	hit_taken.emit(global_position)
	_check_death()


func ignite() -> void:
	var was_burning := is_burning()
	burn_time_left = Tuning.BURN_DURATION
	if not was_burning:
		burning_started.emit()


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_dead() or is_queued_for_deletion():   # a reset in the same tick must not hit the gate
		return
	if is_burning():
		var burned := minf(delta, burn_time_left)
		hp -= Tuning.BURN_DPS * burned
		burn_time_left -= delta
		# Summing 240 deltas of 1/60 leaves ~1e-14 instead of 0, which used to add a 241st tick.
		if burn_time_left <= BURN_END_EPSILON:
			burn_time_left = 0.0
			burning_ended.emit()
		_check_death()
		if is_dead():
			return
	if at_wall:
		attacking_gate.emit(Tuning.SCARECROW_GATE_DPS * delta)
	else:
		position.y = minf(position.y + Tuning.SCARECROW_SPEED * delta, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y)
		at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y


func _check_death() -> void:
	if is_dead():
		remove_from_group("enemies")
		died.emit()
		queue_free()

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p logs
if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
    fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
else
    fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
fi
log="logs/$(basename "$1" .gd)_${tag}.log"
timeout "${3:-120}" godot --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path godot --script "res://tests/$1" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
status=$?
if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR|Failed loading resource" "$log"; then status=1; fi
exit $status

extends Node2D
## One prototype run: survive SURVIVE_TIME seconds of scarecrows without losing the gate.
## Owns the run state (gate HP, elapsed time, kills, win/lose). Restart with R/Enter at the end.

signal state_changed(new_state: State)

enum State { PLAYING, WON, LOST }

const SCARECROW_SCENE := preload("res://game/scarecrow.tscn")
const ARCHER_START := Vector2(640, 572)

@export var spawning_enabled := true
## (start, end) spawn interval used instead of Tuning's when non-zero; only tools/balance_sim.gd sets it.
var spawn_interval_override := Vector2.ZERO

var state: State = State.PLAYING
var gate_hp: float = Tuning.GATE_HP
var elapsed := 0.0
var kills := 0
var spawn_timer := 0.0
var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()

@onready var world: Node2D = $World
@onready var enemies: Node2D = $World/Enemies
@onready var arrows: Node2D = $World/Arrows
@onready var archer: Archer = $World/Archer


func _ready() -> void:
	rng.randomize()
	archer.arrows_parent = arrows
	reset()


func reset() -> void:
	for child in enemies.get_children() + arrows.get_children():
		if child.is_in_group("enemies"):
			child.remove_from_group("enemies")
		child.queue_free()
	gate_hp = Tuning.GATE_HP
	elapsed = 0.0
	kills = 0
	spawn_timer = 1.0
	archer.position = ARCHER_START
	archer.fire_cooldown = 0.0
	world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
	_set_state(State.PLAYING)


func spawn_scarecrow(at: Vector2) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := SCARECROW_SCENE.instantiate() as Scarecrow
	s.position = at
	s.died.connect(func() -> void: kills += 1)
	s.attacking_gate.connect(_on_attacking_gate)
	enemies.add_child(s)
	return s


func spawn_interval() -> float:
	var t := clampf(elapsed / Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME, 0.0, 1.0)
	if spawn_interval_override != Vector2.ZERO:
		return lerpf(spawn_interval_override.x, spawn_interval_override.y, t)
	return lerpf(Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_START, Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_END, t)


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if state != State.PLAYING:
		return
	elapsed += delta
	if elapsed >= Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME:
		_end(State.WON)
		return
	if spawning_enabled:
		spawn_timer -= delta
		if spawn_timer <= 0.0:
			spawn_timer += spawn_interval()
			spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(rng.randf_range(60.0, Tuning.VIEW.x - 60.0), -40.0))


func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if state != State.PLAYING and event.is_action_pressed("restart"):
		reset()


func _on_attacking_gate(amount: float) -> void:
	if state != State.PLAYING:
		return
	gate_hp = maxf(gate_hp - amount, 0.0)
	if gate_hp <= 0.0:
		_end(State.LOST)


func _end(result: State) -> void:
	world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED   # freeze the field; HUD shows the result
	_set_state(result)


func _set_state(s: State) -> void:
	state = s
	state_changed.emit(s)

extends Node2D
## Straw Scarecrow: walks down to the wall and hits the gate. Straw burns.
## Owns the Burning state: burn_time_left > 0 means burning. Fire refreshes it to the full
## BURN_DURATION (a second hit does not stack damage). Timed in physics time, so it follows
## Engine.time_scale and stops while the tree is paused.

signal burning_started
signal burning_ended
signal died
signal attacking_gate(amount: float)
signal hit_taken(position: Vector2)

const BURN_END_EPSILON := 1e-9      # s; float residue below this counts as burnt out

var hp: float = Tuning.SCARECROW_HP
var burn_time_left: float = 0.0
var at_wall := false


func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("enemies")
	at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y


func is_burning() -> bool:
	return burn_time_left > 0.0


func is_dead() -> bool:
	return hp <= 0.0


func hit(damage: float, element: StringName) -> void:
	if is_dead():
		return
	hp -= damage
	if element == &"fire":
		ignite()
	hit_taken.emit(global_position)
	_check_death()


func ignite() -> void:
	var was_burning := is_burning()
	burn_time_left = Tuning.BURN_DURATION
	if not was_burning:
		burning_started.emit()


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_dead() or is_queued_for_deletion():   # a reset in the same tick must not hit the gate
		return
	if is_burning():
		var burned := minf(delta, burn_time_left)
		hp -= Tuning.BURN_DPS * burned
		burn_time_left -= delta
		# Summing 240 deltas of 1/60 leaves ~1e-14 instead of 0, which used to add a 241st tick.
		if burn_time_left <= BURN_END_EPSILON:
			burn_time_left = 0.0
			burning_ended.emit()
		_check_death()
		if is_dead():
			return
	if at_wall:
		attacking_gate.emit(Tuning.SCARECROW_GATE_DPS * delta)
	else:
		position.y = minf(position.y + Tuning.SCARECROW_SPEED * delta, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y)
		at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y


func _check_death() -> void:
	if is_dead():
		remove_from_group("enemies")
		died.emit()
		queue_free()

		if d < best_d:
			best_d = d
			best = s
	return best


func _aimed_at(arrow: Arrow) -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_a := INF
	for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := n as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead():
			continue
		var a := absf(arrow.velocity.angle_to(s.global_position - arrow.position))
		if a < best_a:
			best_a = a
			best = s
	return best if best_a < 1e-3 else null


func _label(s: Scarecrow) -> String:
	return "none" if s == null else str(labels.get(s.get_instance_id(), "?"))


func _live_arrows() -> int:
	var n := 0
	for c in game.arrows.get_children():
		if not c.is_queued_for_deletion():
			n += 1
	return n


func _spawn(at: Vector2, label: String) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(at)
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	tracked.append(id)
	labels[id] = label
	s.died.connect(func() -> void: deaths[label] = {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1})
	return s


func _shots_in(sc: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for s in shots:
		if s["scen"] == sc:
			out.append(s)
	return out


func _gaps(list: Array[Dictionary]) -> Array:
	var out := []
	for i in range(1, list.size()):
		out.append(int(list[i]["f"]) - int(list[i - 1]["f"]))
	return out


# ---- listeners (read only) ----------------------------------------------------------------------

func _on_fired(arrow: Arrow) -> void:
	var tgt := _aimed_at(arrow)
	var near := _nearest_in_cone()
	var ev := {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1, "gt": gt + 1, "act": act + 1, "run": run_id,
		"pf": Engine.get_process_frames(), "target": _label(tgt), "nearest": _label(near),
		"in_cone": tgt != null and _in_cone(tgt), "parent_ok": arrow.get_parent() == game.arrows,
		"paused": paused, "state": game.state}
	pending.append(ev)
	shots.append(ev)


func _on_state_changed(s: Game.State) -> void:
	# Emitted by a key the script sends between ticks (restart; dispatch is synchronous): stamp the
	# current f. Emitted during the nodes' tick (the loss): stamp that tick, f + 1.
	# (Engine.is_in_physics_frame() cannot tell them apart: the script resumes inside the physics step.)
	var in_tick := not dispatching_key
	transitions.append({"scen": scen, "f": f + 1 if in_tick else f, "gt": gt, "state": s,
		"key": last_key, "key_age": -1 if in_tick else gt - last_key_gt})


# ---- one frame ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _step() -> void:
	next_active = not paused and game.world.process_mode != Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	await physics_frame
	f += 1
	gt += 1
	if next_active:
		act += 1
	var cd := game.archer.fire_cooldown

	if not next_active:
		if not pending.is_empty():
			inv_inactive_shots += pending.size()
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d shot] " % [scen, f]
		if cd != prev_cd:
			inv_inactive_cd_changes += 1
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d cd %.6f->%.6f] " % [scen, f, prev_cd, cd]
	if arrows_added != pending.size():
		inv_arrow_mismatch += 1
		inv_arrow_detail += "[%s f=%d arrows=%d fired=%d] " % [scen, f, arrows_added, pending.size()]

	var fired_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for e in pending:
		fired_txt.append("%s(nearest %s, pf %d)" % [e["target"], e["nearest"], e["pf"]])
	var sc_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for id in tracked:
		var s := _live(id)
		if s == null:
			wall_prev.erase(id)
			continue
		sc_txt.append("%s y=%.2f wall=%s hp=%.2f burn=%s cone=%s" % [labels[id], s.position.y,
			s.at_wall, s.hp, s.is_burning(), _in_cone(s)])
		if wall_prev.has(id) and bool(wall_prev[id][0]) and not is_equal_approx(float(wall_prev[id][1]), s.position.y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d y %.2f->%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, wall_prev[id][1], s.position.y]
		if s.at_wall and not is_equal_approx(s.position.y, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d at_wall but y=%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, s.position.y]
		wall_prev[id] = [s.at_wall, s.position.y]

	print("%d | %s f=%d | state=%s paused=%s x=%.2f cd=%.6f arrows=%d | fired=[%s] | %s" % [
		Engine.get_process_frames(), scen, f, Game.State.keys()[game.state], paused,
		game.archer.position.x, cd, _live_arrows(), ", ".join(fired_txt), "; ".join(sc_txt)])
	pending.clear()
	arrows_added = 0
	prev_cd = cd


func _begin(name: String) -> void:
	scen = name
	f = 0
	print("---- scenario %s ----" % name)


## Wait until no tracked scarecrow (except keep_ids) is alive, no arrow flies and the cooldown is 0.
func _settle(keep: Array[int] = []) -> void:
	var cap := 900
	while cap > 0:
		var busy := _live_arrows() > 0 or game.archer.fire_cooldown > 0.0
		for id in tracked:
			if not keep.has(id) and _live(id) != null:
				busy = true
		if not busy:
			break
		await _step()
		cap -= 1
	for i in 3:
		await _step()

# ---- invariants over every shot of the whole test ------------------------------------------------

func _global_invariants() -> void:
	var no_target := PackedStringArray()
	var not_nearest := PackedStringArray()
	var bad_parent := 0
	var during_pause := 0
	for e in shots:
		if e["target"] == "none" or not e["in_cone"]:
			no_target.append("%s f%d" % [e["scen"], e["f"]])
		if e["target"] != e["nearest"]:
			not_nearest.append("%s f%d %s!=%s" % [e["scen"], e["f"], e["target"], e["nearest"]])
		if not e["parent_ok"]:
			bad_parent += 1
		if e["paused"] or e["state"] != Game.State.PLAYING:
			during_pause += 1
	var close := PackedStringArray()
	var min_gap := 1 << 30
	for k in range(1, shots.size()):

extends SceneTree
## Step 2 pins (CHANGE-BRIEF §5, §10): what the archer does NOW, before any clip exists.
## Drives the real main scene only through keyboard events (Input.parse_input_event); never calls an
## archer or scarecrow method that changes state, never assigns to their variables. It only spawns
## scarecrows with Game.spawn_scarecrow() and reads state.
##   ./scripts/run-test.sh test_pins_a7.gd 60
##
## Frame model. --fixed-fps 60 and 60 physics ticks/s: one main-loop iteration = one physics tick.
## The script resumes on SceneTree.physics_frame, which is emitted BEFORE the nodes' physics step.
## So at each resume the world shows the result of the previous tick, and whatever the script does
## there (keys, spawns) takes effect in the next tick. A scenario's frame f counts game ticks
## completed since the scenario's setup (f = 0 is the setup itself). An event emitted during a
## tick (fired, died) is stamped with that tick's f and shows up in the log line of the same f.
## Every log line begins with Engine.get_process_frames() at the moment it is printed. Measured: an
## event emitted during the tick reports a process frame one lower (line "4 | a f=1" carries
## "fired ... pf 3"), so line P shows the state left by the physics tick of process frame P - 1.
##
## TIMING = numbers the brief changes on purpose (§5); re-pinned in Step 6.
## INVARIANT = must survive the change.

const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0
const FIRE_INTERVAL_TICKS := 36            # Tuning.FIRE_INTERVAL (0.6 s) at 60 ticks/s

# ---- scenario design (chosen, not measured) ----------------------------------------------------
const C_HOLD_D_TICKS := 40                 # (c) D held for ticks 1..40, then A for ticks 41..80
const C_HOLD_A_TICKS := 40
const D_PAUSE_AT_F := 15                   # (d) P pressed after tick 15 ...
const D_PAUSE_TICKS := 30                  # ... and again 30 ticks later
const E_WALL_HOLD_TICKS := 30              # (e) ticks watched after the scarecrow reaches the wall
const F_FROZEN_TICKS := 30                 # (f) ticks watched after the loss before R

# ---- TIMING: measured on baseline 2026-11-21 ----------------------------------------------------
const A_FIRST_SHOT_F := 1                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (a) spawn (in the cone, cooldown 0) at f 0 -> first fired
const A_SHOT_GAPS := [36, 36, 36]          # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (a) shots at f 1, 37, 73, 109
const A_DEATH_F := 118                     # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (a) the 4th arrow kills it
const B_FIRST_SHOT_F := 1                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21
const B_SHOT_GAPS := [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 36]   # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: 4 on B_near, 4 on B_far
const C_FIRST_SHOT_F := 1                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21
const C_EXIT_F := 26                       # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: first frame the target is outside the cone
const C_CD_ZERO_F := 37                    # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: first frame the cooldown is 0 while it is outside
const C_REENTRY_F := 62                    # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: first frame it is back inside the cone
const C_REENTRY_SHOT_DELAY := 0            # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: fired on the re-entry frame itself
const D_SHOT1_F := 1                       # measured on baseline 2026-11-21
const D_SHOT2_F := 67                      # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: 1 + 36 + 30 paused frames
const D_PAUSE_SHIFT := 30                  # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: (shot2 - shot1) - unpaused cadence
const E_WALL_F := 174                      # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: 130 px at 0.75 px/tick, rounded up
const F_LOSS_F := 104                      # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: frame the run is LOST
const F_RESTART_SHOT_DELAY := 1            # measured on baseline 2026-11-21: new run, spawn at f_s -> fired at f_s + 1

var game: Game
var timing: Array[String] = []
var invariant: Array[String] = []
var passed := 0
var failed := 0

var scen := ""
var f := 0                 # ticks completed since the scenario's setup
var gt := 0                # ticks completed since the test started
var run_id := 0            # incremented by each restart
var act := 0               # ticks the archer processed (not paused, World enabled) in this run
var next_active := true    # will the archer process the coming tick?
var prev_cd := 0.0
var pending: Array[Dictionary] = []   # fired events since the last log line
var shots: Array[Dictionary] = []     # every fired event
var arrows_added := 0                 # arrows that entered World/Arrows since the last log line
var tracked: Array[int] = []          # scarecrow instance ids
var labels := {}                      # id -> label
var deaths := {}                      # label -> {scen, f}
var wall_prev := {}                   # id -> [at_wall, y] at the previous log line
var transitions: Array[Dictionary] = []
var last_key := -1
var last_key_gt := -1
var dispatching_key := false

# invariant counters, whole run
var inv_inactive_shots := 0
var inv_inactive_cd_changes := 0
var inv_inactive_detail := ""
var inv_arrow_mismatch := 0
var inv_arrow_detail := ""
var inv_wall_moves := 0
var inv_wall_detail := ""


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	game.archer.fired.connect(_on_fired)
	game.arrows.child_entered_tree.connect(func(_n: Node) -> void: arrows_added += 1)
	game.state_changed.connect(_on_state_changed)
	await process_frame
	scen = "boot"
	for i in 3:
		await _step()

	await _scen_a()
	await _scen_b()
	await _scen_c()
	await _scen_d()
	await _scen_e()
	await _scen_f()
	_global_invariants()

	print("== TIMING (changed on purpose by brief §5; re-pinned in Step 6) ==")
	for line in timing:
		print(line)
	print("== INVARIANT (must survive the change) ==")
	for line in invariant:
		print(line)
	print("RESULT test_pins_a7: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


# ---- checks -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _record(group: Array[String], name: String, ok: bool, detail: String) -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		group.append("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		group.append("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _timing(name: String, measured: Variant, pinned: Variant) -> void:
	_record(timing, "%s = %s" % [name, str(pinned)], measured == pinned, "measured %s" % str(measured))


func _inv(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	_record(invariant, name, ok, detail)


# ---- input --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	if pressed:
		last_key = code
		last_key_gt = gt
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = code
	ev.physical_keycode = code
	ev.pressed = pressed
	dispatching_key = true
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()
	dispatching_key = false


func _tap(code: Key) -> void:
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)


# ---- reading the world --------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _in_cone(s: Scarecrow) -> bool:
	var to := s.global_position - game.archer.global_position
	return absf(Vector2.UP.angle_to(to)) <= deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0)


func _live(id: int) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := instance_from_id(id) as Scarecrow
	if s == null or not s.is_inside_tree() or s.is_queued_for_deletion() or s.is_dead():
		return null
	return s


func _nearest_in_cone() -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_d := INF
	for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := n as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead() or not _in_cone(s):
			continue
		var d := (s.global_position - game.archer.global_position).length()
		if d < best_d:
			best_d = d
			best = s
	return best


func _aimed_at(arrow: Arrow) -> Scarecrow:
	var best: Scarecrow = null
	var best_a := INF
	for n in get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := n as Scarecrow
		if s == null or s.is_dead():
			continue
		var a := absf(arrow.velocity.angle_to(s.global_position - arrow.position))
		if a < best_a:
			best_a = a
			best = s
	return best if best_a < 1e-3 else null


func _label(s: Scarecrow) -> String:
	return "none" if s == null else str(labels.get(s.get_instance_id(), "?"))


func _live_arrows() -> int:
	var n := 0
	for c in game.arrows.get_children():
		if not c.is_queued_for_deletion():
			n += 1
	return n


func _spawn(at: Vector2, label: String) -> Scarecrow:
	var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(at)
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	tracked.append(id)
	labels[id] = label
	s.died.connect(func() -> void: deaths[label] = {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1})
	return s


func _shots_in(sc: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
	for s in shots:
		if s["scen"] == sc:
			out.append(s)
	return out


func _gaps(list: Array[Dictionary]) -> Array:
	var out := []
	for i in range(1, list.size()):
		out.append(int(list[i]["f"]) - int(list[i - 1]["f"]))
	return out


# ---- listeners (read only) ----------------------------------------------------------------------

func _on_fired(arrow: Arrow) -> void:
	var tgt := _aimed_at(arrow)
	var near := _nearest_in_cone()
	var ev := {"scen": scen, "f": f + 1, "gt": gt + 1, "act": act + 1, "run": run_id,
		"pf": Engine.get_process_frames(), "target": _label(tgt), "nearest": _label(near),
		"in_cone": tgt != null and _in_cone(tgt), "parent_ok": arrow.get_parent() == game.arrows,
		"paused": paused, "state": game.state}
	pending.append(ev)
	shots.append(ev)


func _on_state_changed(s: Game.State) -> void:
	# Emitted by a key the script sends between ticks (restart; dispatch is synchronous): stamp the
	# current f. Emitted during the nodes' tick (the loss): stamp that tick, f + 1.
	# (Engine.is_in_physics_frame() cannot tell them apart: the script resumes inside the physics step.)
	var in_tick := not dispatching_key
	transitions.append({"scen": scen, "f": f + 1 if in_tick else f, "gt": gt, "state": s,
		"key": last_key, "key_age": -1 if in_tick else gt - last_key_gt})


# ---- one frame ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func _step() -> void:
	next_active = not paused and game.world.process_mode != Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
	await physics_frame
	f += 1
	gt += 1
	if next_active:
		act += 1
	var cd := game.archer.fire_cooldown

	if not next_active:
		if not pending.is_empty():
			inv_inactive_shots += pending.size()
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d shot] " % [scen, f]
		if cd != prev_cd:
			inv_inactive_cd_changes += 1
			inv_inactive_detail += "[%s f=%d cd %.6f->%.6f] " % [scen, f, prev_cd, cd]
	if arrows_added != pending.size():
		inv_arrow_mismatch += 1
		inv_arrow_detail += "[%s f=%d arrows=%d fired=%d] " % [scen, f, arrows_added, pending.size()]

	var fired_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for e in pending:
		fired_txt.append("%s(nearest %s, pf %d)" % [e["target"], e["nearest"], e["pf"]])
	var sc_txt := PackedStringArray()
	for id in tracked:
		var s := _live(id)
		if s == null:
			wall_prev.erase(id)
			continue
		sc_txt.append("%s y=%.2f wall=%s hp=%.2f burn=%s cone=%s" % [labels[id], s.position.y,
			s.at_wall, s.hp, s.is_burning(), _in_cone(s)])
		if wall_prev.has(id) and bool(wall_prev[id][0]) and not is_equal_approx(float(wall_prev[id][1]), s.position.y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d y %.2f->%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, wall_prev[id][1], s.position.y]
		if s.at_wall and not is_equal_approx(s.position.y, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y):
			inv_wall_moves += 1
			inv_wall_detail += "[%s %s f=%d at_wall but y=%.2f] " % [scen, labels[id], f, s.position.y]
		wall_prev[id] = [s.at_wall, s.position.y]

	print("%d | %s f=%d | state=%s paused=%s x=%.2f cd=%.6f arrows=%d | fired=[%s] | %s" % [
		Engine.get_process_frames(), scen, f, Game.State.keys()[game.state], paused,
		game.archer.position.x, cd, _live_arrows(), ", ".join(fired_txt), "; ".join(sc_txt)])
	pending.clear()
	arrows_added = 0
	prev_cd = cd


func _begin(name: String) -> void:
	scen = name
	f = 0
	print("---- scenario %s ----" % name)


## Wait until no tracked scarecrow (except keep_ids) is alive, no arrow flies and the cooldown is 0.
func _settle(keep: Array[int] = []) -> void:
	var cap := 900
	while cap > 0:
		var busy := _live_arrows() > 0 or game.archer.fire_cooldown > 0.0
		for id in tracked:
			if not keep.has(id) and _live(id) != null:
				busy = true
		if not busy:
			break
		await _step()
		cap -= 1
	for i in 3:
		await _step()


# ---- scenarios ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## (a) One scarecrow in the cone, cooldown 0: the first shots until it dies.
func _scen_a() -> void:
	_begin("a")
	var cd0 := game.archer.fire_cooldown
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 300), "A1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	var in_cone0 := _in_cone(s)
	while _live(id) != null and f < 600:
		await _step()
	var list := _shots_in("a")
	var first := int(list[0]["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1
	print("MEASURED a: cooldown at spawn %.6f, in cone at spawn %s, shots at f %s, gaps %s, died at f %s" % [
		cd0, in_cone0, str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), str(_gaps(list)),
		str(deaths.get("A1", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(a) setup: cooldown 0 and the scarecrow inside the cone at spawn", cd0 == 0.0 and in_cone0)
	_timing("(a) first fired frame after a spawn in the cone (spawn = f 0)", first, A_FIRST_SHOT_F)
	_timing("(a) frames between consecutive shots", _gaps(list), A_SHOT_GAPS)
	_timing("(a) frame the scarecrow dies", int(deaths.get("A1", {}).get("f", -1)), A_DEATH_F)
	await _settle()


## (b) Two scarecrows in the cone: which one is taken, and the cadence.
func _scen_b() -> void:
	_begin("b")
	var near := _spawn(Vector2(600, 350), "B_near")
	var far := _spawn(Vector2(690, 250), "B_far")
	var ids: Array[int] = [near.get_instance_id(), far.get_instance_id()]
	var both_in := _in_cone(near) and _in_cone(far)
	while (_live(ids[0]) != null or _live(ids[1]) != null) and f < 900:
		await _step()
	var list := _shots_in("b")
	var targets := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> String: return e["target"])
	print("MEASURED b: shots at f %s, targets %s, gaps %s, B_near died f %s, B_far died f %s" % [
		str(list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])), str(targets), str(_gaps(list)),
		str(deaths.get("B_near", {}).get("f", -1)), str(deaths.get("B_far", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(b) setup: both scarecrows inside the cone at spawn", both_in)
	var near_first: bool = not list.is_empty() and list[0]["target"] == "B_near"
	_inv("(b) the first shot takes the nearer scarecrow (B_near)", near_first, "targets %s" % str(targets))
	var b_near_death: int = deaths.get("B_near", {}).get("f", 1 << 30)
	var order_ok := true
	for e in list:
		var expect := "B_near" if int(e["f"]) <= b_near_death else "B_far"
		if e["target"] != expect:
			order_ok = false
	_inv("(b) every shot takes B_near while it lives, then B_far", order_ok and list.size() >= 2,
		"targets %s" % str(targets))
	_timing("(b) first fired frame after the spawn", int(list[0]["f"]) if not list.is_empty() else -1,
		B_FIRST_SHOT_F)
	_timing("(b) frames between consecutive shots", _gaps(list), B_SHOT_GAPS)
	await _settle()


## (c) The target leaves the cone because the archer moves away (D held), and comes back (A held).
func _scen_c() -> void:
	_begin("c")
	var s := _spawn(Vector2(640, 450), "C1")
	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	var exit_f := -1
	var cd_zero_f := -1
	var reentry_f := -1
	var moved_ok := 0
	var moved_bad := 0
	var moved_detail := ""
	while _live(id) != null and f < 400:
		var x0 := game.archer.position.x
		var cd_before := game.archer.fire_cooldown
		var holding := f < C_HOLD_D_TICKS + C_HOLD_A_TICKS   # a move key is held for tick f + 1
		await _step()
		if holding and cd_before > 1.5 * TICK:
			var dx := absf(game.archer.position.x - x0)
			if absf(dx - Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK) < 1e-6:
				moved_ok += 1
			else:
				moved_bad += 1
				moved_detail += "[f=%d dx=%.4f] " % [f, dx]
		var c := _live(id)
		if c != null:
			var inc := _in_cone(c)
			if exit_f < 0 and not inc:
				exit_f = f
			elif exit_f >= 0 and reentry_f < 0 and inc:
				reentry_f = f
		if exit_f >= 0 and reentry_f < 0 and cd_zero_f < 0 and game.archer.fire_cooldown == 0.0:
			cd_zero_f = f
		if f == C_HOLD_D_TICKS:
			_key(KEY_D, false)
			_key(KEY_A, true)
		elif f == C_HOLD_D_TICKS + C_HOLD_A_TICKS:
			_key(KEY_A, false)
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	_key(KEY_A, false)
	var list := _shots_in("c")
	var fs := list.map(func(e: Dictionary) -> int: return e["f"])
	var out_shots := 0
	var reentry_shot := -1
	for e in list:
		if exit_f >= 0 and int(e["f"]) >= exit_f and (reentry_f < 0 or int(e["f"]) < reentry_f):
			out_shots += 1
		if reentry_f >= 0 and reentry_shot < 0 and int(e["f"]) >= reentry_f:
			reentry_shot = int(e["f"])
	print("MEASURED c: shots at f %s, exit f %d, cooldown 0 at f %d, re-entry f %d, re-entry shot f %d, died f %s" % [
		str(fs), exit_f, cd_zero_f, reentry_f, reentry_shot, str(deaths.get("C1", {}).get("f", -1))])
	_inv("(c) no shot while the target is outside the cone, though the cooldown is 0",
		exit_f > 0 and reentry_f > exit_f and cd_zero_f >= exit_f and out_shots == 0,
		"exit %d cd0 %d reentry %d shots between %d" % [exit_f, cd_zero_f, reentry_f, out_shots])
	_inv("the archer moves %.0f px per tick while the cooldown runs (%d ticks checked)" % [
		Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK, moved_ok], moved_ok > 0 and moved_bad == 0, moved_detail)
	_timing("(c) first fired frame after the spawn", int(fs[0]) if not fs.is_empty() else -1, C_FIRST_SHOT_F)
	_timing("(c) frame the target leaves the cone", exit_f, C_EXIT_F)
	_timing("(c) frame the cooldown reaches 0 while it is outside", cd_zero_f, C_CD_ZERO_F)
	_timing("(c) frame the target is back in the cone", reentry_f, C_REENTRY_F)
	_timing("(c) fired frame - re-entry frame", reentry_shot - reentry_f, C_REENTRY_SHOT_DELAY)
	await _settle()


## (d) P pressed mid-cooldown, and again D_PAUSE_TICKS frames later.

	var id := s.get_instance_id()
	var paused_ok := false
	var resumed_ok := false
	var frozen_y := true
	var y_at_pause := 0.0
	var cd_at_pause := -1.0

		var c := _live(id)

			cd_at_pause = game.archer.fire_cooldown
			y_at_pause = c.position.y if c else 0.0
			_tap(KEY_P)

		elif f > D_PAUSE_AT_F and f <= D_PAUSE_AT_F + D_PAUSE_TICKS:

				_tap(KEY_P)
				resumed_ok = not paused

	var s2 := int(fs[1]) if fs.size() > 1 else -1

	var later := _gaps(list).slice(1)

func _global_invariants() -> void:
	var no_target := PackedStringArray()
	var not_nearest := PackedStringArray()
	var bad_parent := 0
	var during_pause := 0
	for e in shots:
		if e["target"] == "none" or not e["in_cone"]:

		if e["target"] != e["nearest"]:
			not_nearest.append("%s f%d %s!=%s" % [e["scen"], e["f"], e["target"], e["nearest"]])

			bad_parent += 1
		if e["paused"] or e["state"] != Game.State.PLAYING:

	var close := PackedStringArray()
	var min_gap := 1 << 30

	print("INFO %d shots in total; smallest gap in archer-active frames within a run: %d" % [shots.size(), min_gap])

	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game

	await _test_move(KEY_A, -1.0, "A")
	await _test_move(KEY_LEFT, -1.0, "Left arrow")
	await _test_clamp()
	await _test_pause(KEY_ESCAPE, "Esc")
	await _test_pause(KEY_P, "P")
	await _test_restart()

	print("test_input: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


func _check(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		print("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		print("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var ev := InputEventKey.new()
	ev.keycode = code
	ev.physical_keycode = code
	ev.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()


func _seconds(s: float) -> void:
	for i in roundi(s / TICK):
		await physics_frame


func _test_move(code: Key, sign_x: float, label: String) -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	var x0 := game.archer.position.x
	_key(code, true)
	await _seconds(0.5)
	_key(code, false)
	await _seconds(0.1)
	var moved := game.archer.position.x - x0
	var expect := sign_x * Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * 0.5
	_check("%s moves the archer %+.0f px in 0.5 s" % [label, expect],
			absf(moved - expect) <= Tuning.ARCHER_SPEED * TICK + 0.01, "moved %.2f" % moved)


func _test_clamp() -> void:
	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	_key(KEY_D, true)
	await _seconds(3.0)
	_key(KEY_D, false)
	_check("the archer stops at the right edge",

			"x=%.2f" % game.archer.position.x)

	game.reset()
	await process_frame
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("%s pauses" % label, paused)
	var t := game.elapsed
	await _seconds(0.5)
	_check("%s: the run clock stops while paused" % label, game.elapsed == t)
	_key(code, true)
	_key(code, false)
	await process_frame
	_check("%s resumes" % label, not paused)

	await process_frame

class Reader extends Node2D:
	var release_window := false:
		set(v):
			if v != release_window:
				print("  [%s] release_window -> %s written during tick %d (after reader ran: %s)" % [name, v, tick, true])

	var trigger_frame := -1
	var first_true := -1
	var tick := 0
	var cancel_at := -1
	func _physics_process(_d: float) -> void:
		tick += 1
		if name == "A" and (tick >= 9 and tick <= 13 or tick >= 26 and tick <= 29 or tick >= 40 and tick <= 46 or tick >= 69 and tick <= 78):
			var pb = tree.get("parameters/playback")
			print("  [%s] tick %d start: node=%s pos=%.4f rw=%s" % [name, tick, pb.get_current_node(), pb.get_current_play_position(), release_window])
		if release_window and first_true < 0:
			first_true = tick
		if tick == 10:
			trigger_frame = tick
			tree.get("parameters/playback").travel("shoot")
		if tick == 70:
			tree.get("parameters/playback").travel("shoot")
		if tick == 75:
			tree.get("parameters/playback").start("idle")


func _make(priority_tree: int) -> Reader:
	var r := Reader.new()

I've read everything the plan needs. Here it is. Nothing has been edited.

# Plan: Step 5 (state machine, clip playback, structure test)

I checked the scenes for authority conflicts first. **I found none.** `Archer/AnimationPlayer` has no autoplay and nothing plays it. No script writes the rig parts, `release_window` or `Sprite.frame`. `archer.gd:11` already declares `release_window` as a plain var. Nothing keys `Archer.position`.

## Step A: `archer.tscn`, the AnimationTree (§6, §7, rev. 1.4)
I add sub-resources and one node. No clip keys change.
- `Archer/AnimationTree` settings:
  - `anim_player = ../AnimationPlayer`
  - `tree_root` = AnimationNodeStateMachine
  - `callback_mode_process = PHYSICS` (0)
  - `advance_expression_base_node = ".."`
  - `active` and `deterministic` left at their defaults (true)
- States: `idle` → AnimationNodeAnimation `idle`; `shoot` → `shoot`. There are no other states besides the built-in Start/End.
- Transitions, one per pair:
  - Start→idle: `advance_mode` AUTO
  - idle→shoot: ENABLED, IMMEDIATE, xfade 0
  - shoot→idle: AUTO, AT_END, xfade 0
- A startup cancel is `playback.start("idle")`, not a transition (§6).

## Step B: `archer.gd` + one line in `main.gd` (§5, rev. 1.1)
- New: `const DRAW_LEAD := 0.3` (§5.2). It goes in `archer.gd` because `tuning.gd` is out of scope. Also new: `shot_armed`, `locked_target`, and `_playback` read in `@onready`.
- `_physics_process` order:
  1. Movement and the cooldown decrement stay byte-for-byte as they are.
  2. If `shot_armed`:
     - If the locked target is freed, dead or outside the cone → `cancel_shot()` and return.
     - Otherwise, if `release_window` is true → `_fire_at(locked_target)`. The aim uses the target's position at that moment. `fired` is emitted as today, inside `_fire_at`. Then `fire_cooldown = FIRE_INTERVAL` and the flag and target are cleared.
     - Return either way.
  3. Otherwise, if `get_current_node() == "idle"`, `fire_cooldown <= DRAW_LEAD` and `nearest_target()` finds a target → lock it, set `shot_armed`, call `travel("shoot")`.
  - Because only an armed shot can be cancelled, a target that dies during active or recovery has no effect (§5.5).
- `cancel_shot()` clears `shot_armed` and the target and calls `_playback.start("idle")`. It never writes `release_window` (§5.4).
- A new `_in_cone()` helper reuses the same math as `nearest_target()`. `nearest_target()` itself stays untouched.
- `main.gd` `reset()` gets one line, `archer.cancel_shot()`, next to `archer.fire_cooldown = 0.0`.

## Step C: Scarecrow presenter (§1, rev. 1.4)
- New node `Scarecrow/WalkPresenter` (Node) with `godot/game/scarecrow_walk_presenter.gd`.
- In `_process` it picks `"hold" if parent.at_wall else "walk"` and calls `play()` only when that differs from the player's `assigned_animation`.
- It reads `at_wall` and writes nothing. The player stays on IDLE (§7, already the default). `scarecrow.gd` is not changed.

## Step D: `godot/tests/test_archer_state_machine.gd`, run at 60 fps (no audio)
The test drives the real `main.tscn`. It spawns scarecrows with `Game.spawn_scarecrow()`, as the pins do, and sends keys only through `Input.parse_input_event`. It never calls `travel`, `start` or `cancel_shot`.

| Assertion | Brief rule |
|---|---|
| `tree_root` is a state machine; its states are exactly idle and shoot, each pointing at a clip that exists in the library | §6 |
| Every state name in a `travel`/`start` call in `archer.gd` exists, and every `play()` name in the presenter exists in the scarecrow library (both read from the source text) | template, §6 |
| There are exactly 3 transitions with no duplicate pair, each with the `advance_mode`, `switch_mode` and `xfade_time` from the table above | §6 |
| `advance_expression_base_node == ".."` and it resolves to `Archer`; `anim_player` resolves to `Archer/AnimationPlayer`; `callback_mode_process == PHYSICS` | §6, §7 |
| `Archer/AnimationPlayer` has empty autoplay, and `current_animation == ""` and `is_playing()` is false for the **whole** run | §8 one authority |
| `get_current_node() == "idle"` after the first tick | §6 Start→idle |
| From the first tick `shot_armed` is true (the travel) to `fired` is exactly 18 ticks. `release_window` reads false two ticks before the shot and true one tick before; `fired` comes on the tick of the first true read; `shot_armed` is false after | §5.1, §5.2, §4, §12 #3 |
| Back-to-back `fired` gaps are exactly 36 ticks | §5.2 |
| Each later draw starts on the tick the cooldown first reaches ≤ 0.3 s, checked on the tick before, the tick of and the tick after | §5.2, §10 |
| Every `fired` arrives while `get_current_node() == "shoot"` | §6, §7 |
| A scarecrow's `current_animation` is `walk` while walking and `hold` when `at_wall` turns true; after that `assigned_animation == "hold"` and `Sprite.frame == 0` | §1 |
| **Recommended extra 1:** D is held during startup so the target leaves the cone. Then: no `fired`, the state is idle on the next tick, the archer still moves 7 px per tick, and the cooldown continues | §5.5 |
